# Production AI Framework

Agent-independent enterprise AI planning and operations knowledge.

- [Start here](START_HERE.md): instructions and expected outputs for any agent.
- [Complete text context](dist/agent-context.md): attach or load directly.
- [Structured bundle](dist/knowledge.json): stable IDs, text, origin, and hashes.
- [Five pillars](docs/pillars.md): evaluation, observability, data foundations, orchestration, governance.
- [Agent integration](docs/agent-integration.md): generic context and retrieval interfaces.
- [Source notes](docs/source-notes.md): attribution and limitations.
- [Source ingestion instructions](ingestion/README.md): add a new transcript or document with any model.
- [Single-file ingestion kit](dist/source-ingestion-kit.md): upload alongside a source; includes rules, schema, and example.
